status: Saved for integration; not activated in production.
purpose: Apply common knowledge once per company member, then add service/task requirements for the roles actually held. A service's flattened family union must never become an all-person assignment list.

rules.purpose: Participation, safe intervention, understandable induction, ergonomics, reporting and emergency actions. Site-specific implementation remains separate.
Resource the program, control scope, manage competence and training assurance, maintain trustworthy exposure records and review changes/improvement.

Only where actual lower-tier work is procured or coordinated.

serviceRuleReconciliation: The individual source reviews retain their original role descriptions. During executable bundle integration, replace their generic company-worker/manager blocks with these shared common rules and retain the service-specific specialist blocks, task conditions and provenance. This prevents inconsistent core assignments across service subsets.
scoring: Deduplicate each current member/course across all selected services and held roles. A completed applicable, trusted-version course contributes once. Missing course material remains outstanding; vendor extras never enlarge the denominator or numerator. Unmapped service scope and unresolved role/exposure applicability prevent a verified-complete claim.
sourceScope: Common applicability and course purposes are recorded in research/safety-program/2026-10-31/library-inventory/inventory.csv. These are company baseline decisions, not claims that every publisher mandates the exact VNDRLY bundle.
